name: 86 Chaos 16.0.112 Tenant Isolation and Forced Password Security Hotfix
label: 86 Chaos 16.0.112 Tenant Isolation and Forced Password Security Hotfix
releaseTitle: 86 Chaos 16.0.112 Tenant Isolation and Forced Password Security Hotfix
notes: Requires profile-photo writers to belong to the restaurant in the Storage path, closing the cross-tenant self-upload loophole.
Moves forced-password completion to an authenticated server route so users cannot directly clear password-reset flags in Firestore.
Safely reads optional email claims and removes the permanently false manager-role helper without changing permission-based manager access.
Adds emulator and server regression tests for tenant isolation, protected password-state fields, recent-auth enforcement, and legacy email-keyed profiles.
